title: CYB 112 - Network Security and Cyber Law

items.q: Which of the following best describes Packet sniffing?
o: a practical exercise in which learners find hidden flags on test systems
a test environment cut off from production so experiments cause no harm
the disciplined recovery of evidence from digital devices for investigation
capturing network traffic to read the data it carries
items.s: Packet sniffing: capturing network traffic to read the data it carries. The other options describe Digital forensics, Isolated lab, Capture the flag.
